As Aramark (ARMK) Stock Value Rose, Steinberg Asset Management Cut Stake; Apple (AAPL) Holder Evanson Asset Management Has Lowered Its Holding by $4.17 Million 
March 22, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Evanson Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 17.13% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Evanson Asset Management Llc sold 27,095 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 131,071 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $20.20M, down from 158,166 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Evanson Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $865.50B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.41% or $0.7   $170.57. About 22.41M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Steinberg Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Aramark (ARMK) by 6.57% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund held 190,580 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $7.74M, down from 203,984 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Steinberg Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Aramark for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.91 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.23% or $0.5   $40.31. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Wednesday, April 6 with “Strong Buy” rating.
